title: The Dillinger Escape Plan Mark the End of the Band
contentHtml:
In an interview with Noisey, The Dillinger Escape Plan broke the news that this upcoming album, Dissociation, will be their last. It's terribly upsetting to hear that one of metal’s elite won’t be around anymore after 20 years as a deeply respected and highly influential group. Dillinger have officially released their first single off the album, “Limerent Death,” on YouTube, and if you know the band, you know what to expect: the song is a powerhouse of frantic, precise aggression that stands above almost anything else in the scene.

With Dissociation out on October 14th, expect all of us at Metal Lifestyle to do our best to give The Dillinger Escape Plan, an outfit that has been on the forefront of the genre since their inception and affected each of us in ways we can’t fully express, the full and proper send-off they deserve.

Jam some Dillinger today. Don’t get down. Be thankful we got as much as we did, and pray to whomever you pray that their final tour cycle swings through your part of town.

-Metal Lifestyle
